Per PCUF rule: authoritative = latest PROVED with a correct basis; else latest non-proved with a correct basis; else latest flagged. A new correct-basis FAILED record therefore replaces an earlier PROVED record whose basis was a retained emission (e.g. AspisR1BatchedWeightsExtraction M31.reduce_u64); the replaced record stays in `supersedes`. A new basis-incorrect, non-proved record does not replace an earlier proof (it is attached as later_attempt_P2g). PROVED records with a correct basis: 503 -> 569 (+66); open 916 -> 850.

Each PROVED_* theorem states @fresh = @gate-constant for the PCQG_ emission text (Types: Equiv or rfl). They compare the emission with the compiled gate declaration; they do not connect the emission to the frozen Rust source (that is P1/PCQG_ provenance) and, being name-level over callees, are conditional where C7 says so. Gate-compatible Aeneas library used for compilation; the tool of the fresh text is the original Aeneas, recorded per record (aeneas_tool).

No gate definition in this scope shows a body difference that is not explained by the tool classes of C3 or by configuration; PCUG_NONFROZEN_CANDIDATES.json is therefore empty. The M31.mul drift found by P2f is not re-tested here (its emission is not in the P1f set). Absence of a candidate is not evidence of source equality: the 47 loop-encoding and 7 constant diffs hide any semantic difference inside those bodies until the P3 bridges exist.
